simple.meaning: מְדוּרָה (mᵉdûwrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pile of fuel.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְדוּרָה (H4071) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 30:33, with occurrences in Isaiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְדוּרָה (H4071) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְדוּרָה (H4071) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְדוּרָה (mᵉdûwrâh) / H4071 is traced through Isaiah 30:33, Ezekiel 24:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4071. medurah מְדוּרָה noun feminine pile (of wood, etc.) ׳מ Ezek 24:9 ; הרבה ועצים אֵשׁ מְדֻרָתָהּ Isa 30:33 = pyre (so Ges Hi De Che Brd; Ew Di its circuit, compass ).
definitions.rootNote: or מְדֻרָה ; from 1752 in the sense of accumulation ;

occurrences.englishText: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
